messages:
becky: Opening a small PR to tidy the onboarding quickstart: shrink the auth steps, fix two broken links in deploy, and update Node SDK examples to the v3 surface. i'll drop the PR link shortly.

sam: nice. which links are failing? i hit one on the deploy page earlier.

becky: the model catalog link and telemetry opt-in. i'll replace with direct anchors. also converting the JS snippet to the new import pattern but keeping curl first for copy-paste.

raj: please keep the JS example minimal and show both promise and async/await one-liners. folks appreciate both.

becky: will do. planned curl snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-qa","prompt":"Hi"}'`

becky: JS snippet will use `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` and a short `const res = await client.generate(...)`.

maria: add `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` and token scope note. also a quick CORS troubleshooting tip for first deployers.

sam: add a model-pinning one-liner for Dedicated customers to avoid surprise changes.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4132 title: "Onboard: slim auth flow + SDK v3 snippets + link fixes" (be c/o becky)

raj: i'll do a pass and leave inline comments for phrasing and the async example. aim to merge before EOD so the site deploy picks it up.

becky: thanks all, ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
